credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: From left to right: Steve Porter, Eliot Porter, Kathy Porter, Georgia O'Keeffe looking through binoculars, and Marshall Gerard. This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River'.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe and Others Resting on Shore
